'''Evader''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s<ref name="CWA" /> [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]].<ref name="Guide" /> The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] wore [[cupid clone trooper]] [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] with [[Color/Legends|brown]] and green markings and an orange visor.<ref name="CWA" />
